_about: Adam's Logos purchase 'Neo-Scholastic Theology and Philosophy Collection (24 vols)', its titles, authors and publishers as listed on logos.com read 2026-11-03, each found as a pre-1931 Internet Archive scan and its title page read (newest pre-1931 edition where several exist; where only the catalogue was read, the row says so). Mostly the Stonyhurst Philosophical Series and its American counterparts, 1887-1921. One shelf for the bundle; works already on another shelf are not repeated (listed under _excluded). This is philosophy as much as theology: lane B may want to own it. Internet Archive OCR, raw. All published before 1931, so US public domain. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A. No uids minted.
